verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only developer building blocks: an endpoint to read a candidate's latest offer, webhook subscriptions for candidate and employee events, and an MCP server that mentions HR self-service employee lookups. None of it documents a signed offer automatically flowing into onboarding, or HRIS and payroll integrations carrying new-hire data over without re-entry. Building blocks a developer could use to construct this flow earn no credit, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an operations lead, a signed offer flows into onboarding — HRIS and payroll integrations carry the new hire's data over without re-entry
